scopeClaim.statement: Assessment is limited to the single declared expanded obligation for POST /process/text in the supplied fixed source crops; it makes no repository-wide or deployment-completeness claim.

results.explanation: The supplied collection name is passed to the shared validator with access_type='write'. For a non-admin, an existing knowledge-base ID is added to the allowed set only when Knowledges.check_access_by_user_id grants the requested write permission; the fallback allowing names absent from the knowledge-base registry does not apply to an existing knowledge base. Therefore a caller targeting an existing knowledge-base collection without ownership or an explicit write grant is denied with HTTP 403 before save_docs_to_vector_db is called, so the requested unauthorized write is source-refuted.

entry.statement: The assessed entry is POST /process/text, implemented by process_text, and it obtains the caller through get_verified_user.

binding.statement: The principal is the verified non-admin described by the task: a verified user targeting an existing knowledge-base collection without the required write permission.
The target resource is the caller-supplied collection_name, and the task defines it as an existing knowledge-base collection for which the user has no write permission.

condition.statement: When collection_name is supplied, process_text validates that supplied name with access_type='write'; it does not use the content-derived collection-name branch.
The applicable non-admin condition is absence of ownership or an explicit write grant, while the separate admin bypass is not applicable to this principal.

control.statement: The shared validator computes the allowed collection set using filter_accessible_collections with the requested access type, then denies any requested name not in that set with HTTP 403.

For a non-admin targeting a name that is an existing knowledge base, the policy adds it only if check_access_by_user_id grants the requested permission; if that check fails, the non-KB fallback is unavailable because get_knowledge_by_id finds the existing KB.

effect.statement: The protected effect is writing the attacker-selected form content to the selected collection: the content becomes a Document and is passed with collection_name to save_docs_to_vector_db only after validation.
Under the stated no-write-access condition, the request is rejected with HTTP 403 before the vector-database save call, so the unauthorized write is denied.
